title: Dream about some mall
content: I had dream in a huge mall, with long elevator stairs, it was tall, the shops were very big. I remember I was shopping and bought something in a past in this dream, but they haven't remove the security magnet, and it was still in my pocket. So the lady came I was explaining calmly to lady what has happened, and then some huge guy came and dream ended. The colors of the dream: It felt like white, maybe like yellowish. And the shop was way taller then normal irl one. I also had many different dreams about mall related things: zoo inside a mall, my family member working in a mall (slaughterhouse in basement of his mall, and a lot of violence), there was a abandoned post-apo mall, there was a mall like- storage thing with a big parking spot (huuuge, veeery big) and a garden inside. Also a dream about mall with zoo had weird spaces that were very dark and dirty. I can remember just a bit about those dreams, but in retrospect I remember a few more times I dreamt of some sort of shopping places. Oh fuck actually also: I had dream about buying things on some sort of marketplace(i bought some ornaments from a handmade manufacture) , I had dream about cyberpunk-like market( low ceelings, bright colors, weird spaces and weird geometry). One of my more interesting dreams started with me being in both supermarket (it wa in china, it looked like a maze, i was at a noodle and pasta section) and inside a bread store.
